package.name: SubD Modeler
package.description: LightWave-style subdivision (SubD) cage modeling inside the 3D view: extrude, bevel / smooth shift, edge bevel with round segments, loop cut and line knife, crease, symmetry, gizmos and exact numeric input. Converts the Catmull-Clark surface into a parametric B-rep solid that exports to STEP.

workbench.name: SubD Modeler
workbench.description: SubD Modeler workbench: opens the cage modeler and makes B-rep solids from SubD objects.
